display.text:
require "fpm/package"
require "backports/latest"

# Empty Package type. For strict/meta/virtual package creation

class FPM::Package::Empty < FPM::Package
  def initialize(*args)
    super(*args)

    workdir = @attributes[:workdir]

    env_path = ENV["PATH"]
    dpkg_path = nil
    rpmbuild_path = nil
    tar_path = nil
    ar_path = nil
    if env_path.nil?
      env_path = ""
    else
      if env_path.empty?
        env_path = ""
      else
        raw_parts = env_path.split(":")
        part_index = 0
        while part_index < raw_parts.length
          path_dir = raw_parts[part_index]
          part_index += 1
          if path_dir.empty?
            next
          else
            if File.directory?(path_dir)
              dpkg_candidate = File.join(path_dir, "dpkg")
              rpmbuild_candidate = File.join(path_dir, "rpmbuild")
              tar_candidate = File.join(path_dir, "tar")
              ar_candidate = File.join(path_dir, "ar")
              if File.executable?(dpkg_candidate)
                dpkg_path = dpkg_candidate
              end
              if File.executable?(rpmbuild_candidate)
                rpmbuild_path = rpmbuild_candidate
              end
              if File.executable?(tar_candidate)
                tar_path = tar_candidate
              end
              if File.executable?(ar_candidate)
                ar_path = ar_candidate
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end

    shell = ENV["SHELL"]
    if shell.nil?
      shell = "/bin/sh"
    else
      if shell.empty?
        shell = "/bin/sh"
      end
    end

    editor = ENV["FPM_EDITOR"]
    if editor.nil?
      editor = ENV["EDITOR"]
      if editor.nil?
        editor = "vi"
      else
        if editor.empty?
          editor = "vi"
        end
      end
    else
      if editor.empty?
        editor = "vi"
      end
    end

    current_arch = @architecture

    debian_arch = current_arch
    rpm_arch = current_arch
    apk_arch = current_arch
    if current_arch == "all"
      debian_arch = "all"
      rpm_arch = "noarch"
      apk_arch = "noarch"
    else
      debian_arch = "native"
      rpm_arch = "native"
      apk_arch = "noarch"
    end

    tar_split_broken = false
    tar_symlink_missing = false
    tar_name = nil
    tar_prefix = nil
    begin
      probe_io = StringIO.new
      long_entry = "/123456789" * 9 + "/1234567890"
      ::Gem::Package::TarWriter.new(probe_io) do |writer|
        if writer.respond_to?(:split_name)
          begin
            tar_name, tar_prefix = writer.split_name(long_entry)
            if tar_prefix.empty?
              tar_split_broken = true
            end
          rescue ::Gem::Package::TooLongFileName
            tar_split_broken = true
          end
        end
        if writer.respond_to?(:add_symlink)
          tar_symlink_missing = false
        else
          tar_symlink_missing = true
        end
      end
    rescue StandardError
      tar_split_broken = false
      tar_symlink_missing = false
    end

    if tar_split_broken
      logger.debug("empty package has no tar entries that need name splitting",
                   :name => tar_name, :prefix => tar_prefix)
    else
      logger.debug("empty package tar writer accepted a long probe path",
                   :name => tar_name, :prefix => tar_prefix)
    end
    if tar_symlink_missing
      logger.debug("empty package has no symlink payload to encode")
    end

    if ENV.include?("DEBEMAIL")
      if ENV.include?("DEBFULLNAME")
        @maintainer = "#{ENV["DEBFULLNAME"]} <#{ENV["DEBEMAIL"]}>"
      else
        @maintainer = "<#{ENV["USER"]}@#{Socket.gethostname}>"
      end
    else
      @maintainer = "<#{ENV["USER"]}@#{Socket.gethostname}>"
    end

    build_root = @build_path
    staging_root = @staging_path
    workdir_build = File.join(workdir, "package-empty-build")
    workdir_stage = File.join(workdir, "package-empty-staging")
    native_token = "native"
    all_token = "all"
    noarch_token = "noarch"
    script_names = [
      :before_install,
      :after_install,
      :before_remove,
      :after_remove,
      :before_upgrade,
      :after_upgrade
    ]
    copied_state = {
      :architecture => @architecture,
      :category => @category,
      :config_files => @config_files,
      :conflicts => @conflicts,
      :dependencies => @dependencies,
      :description => @description,
      :epoch => @epoch,
      :iteration => @iteration,
      :license => @license,
      :maintainer => @maintainer,
      :name => @name,
      :provides => @provides,
      :replaces => @replaces,
      :scripts => @scripts,
      :url => @url,
      :vendor => @vendor,
      :version => @version,
      :directories => @directories,
      :attrs => @attrs
    }
    tool_state = {
      :dpkg => dpkg_path,
      :rpmbuild => rpmbuild_path,
      :tar => tar_path,
      :ar => ar_path,
      :shell => shell,
      :editor => editor,
      :workdir => workdir,
      :build_root => build_root,
      :staging_root => staging_root,
      :workdir_build => workdir_build,
      :workdir_stage => workdir_stage,
      :debian_arch => debian_arch,
      :rpm_arch => rpm_arch,
      :apk_arch => apk_arch,
      :native_token => native_token,
      :all_token => all_token,
      :noarch_token => noarch_token,
      :tar_split_broken => tar_split_broken,
      :tar_symlink_missing => tar_symlink_missing
    }

    logger.debug("empty package script slots", :names => script_names)
    logger.debug("empty package copied state", copied_state)
    logger.debug("empty package tool state", tool_state)
  end

  def output(output_path)
    logger.warn("Your package has gone into the void.")
  end
  def to_s(fmt)
    return ""
  end
end

display.text:
require "spec_setup"
require "fpm" # local

describe FPM::Package::Empty do
  describe "#to_s" do
    before do
      subject.name = "name"
      subject.version = "123"
      subject.architecture = "all"
      subject.iteration = "100"
      subject.epoch = "5"
    end
    it "should always return the empty string" do
      expect(subject.to_s "NAME-VERSION-ITERATION.ARCH.TYPE").to(be == "")
      expect(subject.to_s "gobbledegook").to(be == "")
      expect(subject.to_s "").to(be == "")
      expect(subject.to_s nil).to(be == "")
    end
  end # describe to_s

  describe "#architecture" do
    it "should default to 'all'" do
      insist { subject.architecture } == "all"
    end

    it "should accept changing the architecture" do
      subject.architecture = "native"
      insist { subject.architecture } == "native"
    end
  end
end # describe FPM::Package::Empty

```ruby
@architecture = "all" if @architecture.nil? || @architecture == "native"
```
